# Path of the Rift-Touched

Some barbarians don't just draw fury from within — they draw it from the wound in reality itself. A Rift-Touched barbarian's rage leaks violet-black energy that corrupts the space around them. They don't protect their allies. They contaminate their enemies.

## Rift Aura

*3rd-level Path of the Rift-Touched feature*

While your Rage is active, a crackling violet-black aura extends 10 feet from you. The aura moves with you. At the start of each enemy's turn inside the aura, they take Rift damage equal to your Rage Damage.

Additionally, enemies inside your aura find their blows weakened — their attack damage rolls are reduced by half your Rage Damage (rounded up). The Rift doesn't just hurt. It siphons.

The aura's light is dim but unmistakable. It casts no useful illumination — just a sickly glow that marks you as Rift-touched.

## Deepening Corruption

*6th-level Path of the Rift-Touched feature*

The Rift doesn't just wound — it settles in. When an enemy ends their turn inside your Rift Aura, they gain one Rift-Touched stack. Each stack increases all damage the creature takes from any source by 1. A creature can have a maximum number of stacks equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

Stacks persist as long as the creature remains inside your aura. The moment they leave, the stacks clear. The Rift lets go slowly — but it does let go.

## Feedback Loop

*10th-level Path of the Rift-Touched feature*

Death feeds the Rift, and the Rift feeds you. When an enemy with at least one Rift-Touched stack dies inside your Rift Aura, you regain hit points equal to your Rage Damage + your Constitution modifier. The energy that corrupts them returns to its source.

## Avatar of the Rift

*14th-level Path of the Rift-Touched feature*

The Rift has claimed enough of you that the boundary between you and it has blurred. While your Rage is active, you gain resistance to all damage types — the Rift simply absorbs what would harm you.

Your aura now carries the Rift's perception. While raging, you can see invisible creatures, see through illusions, and automatically detect hidden doors or hidden creatures within the aura's radius. The Rift sees through the world's lies — and so do you.
